The '''Battle of Tortali IV''' was a space battle between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during which Rebel forces attempted to destroy [[Tortali Platform]], an Imperial [[XQ3 Platform|XQ3 supply platform]] in the [[Tortali system/Legends|Tortali system]].

==The Battle==
The Rebel starfighters attacking Tortali Platform imitated the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], with [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] in [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing space superiority fighters]] escorting [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Gold Squadron]] in venerable [[BTL-A4 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing attack starfighters]]. Meanwhile, Tortali Platform deployed [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|bombers]] to counter the starfighter threat. Rebel forces held a force of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wing interceptors]] from [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] in reserve to reinforce Red and Gold Squadrons. The Empire, meanwhile, sent [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class cruiser]] ''[[Huntsman]]'' and associated [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboats]] to support the outmatched defenders of Tortali Platform.

==Behind the scenes==
As players can participate in the mission "Attack on Tortali Platform" in the computer game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' on either the Rebel or the Imperial side&mdash;both sides have conflicting mission objectives&mdash;and victory is not essential to access the next set of missions, the battle itself is considered canon but the canon outcome is unknown.

The ships listed in this article are those found in the battle [[Operation: Quick Strike]], using the default craft assigned to the player.
